card.name: Linking words in dose-adjustment instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, of, for, the, next, based) right after dose, rate or amount terms in dosing-adjustment text, such as resuming at a lower dose or increasing an infusion rate. Also fires on a few unit and number pieces inside dose schedules.

modes.label: Linking word after dose or rate
modes.description: A short word such as to, of, for, the or next that follows a dose, rate or reduction phrase and leads into the next dose detail.
modes.example: resume JIDEYTRO at the<< next>> lower dose for Grade 4 adverse reactions

modes.label: Pieces of dose schedules
modes.description: Part of a unit or number inside a schedule of doses by day or weight.
